verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no explicit AI-training policy or opt-out. SigNoz can be self-hosted on Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, so users "keep full control of [their] data plane" and telemetry never has to reach the vendor. That indirectly prevents vendor-side model training, but only through the self-hosting workaround. missing for 10: an explicit no-training or data-usage policy for SigNoz Cloud, a documented opt-out control, clarity on how data is handled by the AI/MCP features, and independent corroboration.
